messages.subject: Re: How to have full values instead of e+0x in axis
parts:
Thanks Ben, I got it resolved now ... I used the scale_y_continuous function as below

scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,100000,200000,300000,400000,500000))


Regards,
Dipanjan
